inventory.initial: the card the ring was on when the player last left, else the first card; from Choose a pod the first card by use; from the goal's jump the first card of that filter; with no pods, Sort
inventory.selectors: card.up / down / left / right / back, sort.down, filter.down, find.down and chip.first are the host's answers for the ring where it is (props focus.resolve): a card's neighbour in the grid, the tool above the top row (Sort over the first column, Filter the second, Find the third), the panel's first button right of the right-hand column, the card itself where the ring stays; card.back the card the panel shows
inventory.back: where the inventory was opened from (Home, the reading room in choosing mode, Create): one press

filter.initial: the first chip of the first row
filter.selectors: tchip.up / down / left / right: the chip beside the ring in its row, or the nearest in the row above or below, or the chip itself
filter.back: closes the tray, keeping the filter; the ring on Filter

find.initial: the letter of the first recent word, else the first letter
find.selectors: letter.cur the lit letter; word.first the first word under it; word.up / down / left / right the word beside the ring in its two columns, the strip above the first row
find.back: closes the panel with nothing changed

focus.vectorsNote: UI/UX's vectors for the inventory and the reading room: `resolve` is the host's answer for the selectors at that ring; played with ui/focus.mjs and the face's port (face/tests/vectors/focus.json)

compare.targets: the two papers' Take to the reading room buttons: takeA (this pod, on the left) and takeB (its kin, on the right); the ring opens on takeA
compare.opens: ✓ on the reading room's kin well, or ✓ Compare on a card's panel: this pod on the left, its nearest kin on the right, on the species' first chapter
compare.up: step:up: the previous chapter on both papers, sealed ones included; on the first nothing changes, never a wrap
compare.down: step:down: the next chapter on both papers; on the last nothing changes, never a wrap
compare.left: from takeB the ring goes to takeA; from takeA nothing
compare.right: from takeA the ring goes to takeB; on takeB, step:right swaps the right-hand pod for the next kin of the species (round the kin, the left-hand pod never among them)
compare.confirm: Take to the reading room: that pod onto the bench and the reading room open on it, as Bring onto the bench does
compare.back: closes Compare in one press: the reading room with the ring on the kin, or the inventory with the ring on the card it came from

room.lessonPage: A page holds traits. A trait is one thing that can differ; its look is what this one has.

overlay.lesson: Every trait comes twice, one copy from each parent. One is worn; the other hides, and still passes to children.

rule.only: One copy is enough: whichever copy it carries shows.
rule.hides: Needs both copies: a copy that hides still passes to children.
rule.blend: Mixes: the look falls between its two copies.
rule.asleep: Sleeping: switched off in this mibi; it still passes on and can wake in a child.
